name: Anime.js
role: Light DOM/SVG/object tweening with seekable timelines; GSAP's closest neighbour
summary: Small JavaScript animation engine (v4, modular ESM) that animates CSS properties, SVG attributes and plain JS objects. createTimeline with autoplay off exposes seek, so a harness can drive it frame by frame like a GSAP timeline. Includes stagger, SVG path drawing and morphing helpers, springs and scroll observers. Outputs nothing itself; a capture tool records the page.
use_when: Light DOM/SVG motion where GSAP's plugin set and size are not needed
SVG line drawing and stagger effects with a small dependency
Animating plain JS object values that then feed a canvas draw call
avoid_when: Complex nested timelines with labels and plugins: GSAP
Spring-first React UI motion: Motion or React Spring
v3 snippets: v4 API differs (createTimeline, animate); check installed major
notes: 2026-10-26: seekability of the v4 timeline read from docs only; not run. v3 to v4 renamed the API, so confirm the installed major before writing scenes.

assessment.rationale: Active: v4.5.0 released 2026-06-22, MIT, npm modified 2026-08. Direct GSAP neighbour with seekable timelines; useful lighter alternative, GSAP stays the core clock.
